cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Consistency Check Dialog not updating until resizing the window
cases.description: When I open the consistency check the list for example does not update when scrolling or clicking etc. until I resize the dialog window. (for other dialogs it works fine, for example integrity check) This is the state when trying to click on entries, to scroll or switching the entry type. After resizing it shows the "update" but does not show anything else until I resize the window again.

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix unresponsive "Check Consistency" dialog

Fix #13700

I'm yet to investigate deeply the root cause behind this, it could be a JavaFX bug in ProgressDialog#showAndWait or a bug in our DialogService. The bug happens because for some reason the progress dialog, although it becomes invisible, it does not fully shutdown and keeps being on top of the app preventing interaction with underlying UI.
